# FG-CI-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_fetch_is_job_fetch_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブがリポジトリの固定したコミットを取得できませんでした。ジョブは失敗として報告されました。
- en: The CI job could not fetch the pinned commit of the repository. The job was reported as failed.
- id: Tugas CI tidak dapat mengambil commit yang dipatok dari repositori. Tugas dilaporkan gagal.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C4: `forge-runner` fetches only the job's pinned commit, over Smart HTTP with the job's token (`/api/v1/runner/jobs/{job_id}/repo.git`, which advertises only `refs/pipelines/<pipeline_id>/head`), into a fresh work directory. git failed or ran out of time (`git init`, `git fetch`, `git checkout`), the fetched commit was not the pinned one, or the server refused the copy (the job ended and its token was revoked: FG-AUTH-0001; another project or commit: FG-REPO-0005).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs the failure once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `step` (`init` / `fetch` / `verify` / `checkout` / `read_definition`), `reason` (`exit` / `timeout` / `spawn_failed` / `sha_mismatch`), `exit_code` and `git_stderr` (the last 2 KiB, never the token). On the server, the job route logs the same `job_id` with `route=job_info_refs` / `job_upload_pack`.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner: check that the runner host reaches forge over HTTPS (`curl -sS https://<forge>/healthz`), that git is installed (`git --version`, 2.38 or newer) and that the job was still running. Then retry the pipeline.
